cause: The failed guest journal records repeated NetworkManager network-control Polkit authentication failures at 14:00:42 UTC and pam_faillock temporarily locking omarchy during the full source suite, before the installed checks at 14:02. Booting a new overlay of the preserved failed guest restored sudo; a local comparison verified the original test password is unchanged. The exact individual source test initiating those requests was not isolated.
scope: Only the three failed installed checks rerun in a fresh overlay from the same installed ISO base.
